rows.claim: The three compute contracts total CNY39-46bn including VAT over five years.
rows.evidence: Official A/B/C announcements disclose CNY16-19bn, CNY10-12bn and CNY13-15bn.
rows.model_impact: Annualized gross midpoint CNY8.5bn; base 2026 recognition uses only 25% of annual ex-VAT run-rate.
rows.formal_boundary: accepted server count, unit monthly rent, hardware cost and segment margin are not disclosed

rows.claim: Prior compute contracts have moved beyond framework status.
rows.evidence: The 2026-07-11 official announcement states prior contracts were delivered on schedule, accepted by customers and had recognized revenue.
rows.model_impact: Base compute profit credit rises from zero to CNY0.8bn, but the C-contract remains conditional.
rows.formal_boundary: recognized revenue amount, margin and cash collection are not disclosed

rows.claim: The Qinhuai transaction has shareholder approval but is not completed.
rows.evidence: All shareholder-meeting proposals passed; the transaction still needs SSE review and CSRC registration.
rows.model_impact: Base and bull cases include purchase/placement dilution; bear case retains existing shares.
rows.formal_boundary: review timing, registration, placement price and closing date remain unknown

rows.claim: Qinhuai is profitable and highly utilized, but leveraged and concentrated.
rows.evidence: Official filing: 2025 revenue CNY6.372bn, parent NP CNY0.949bn, gross margin 45.15%, 799MW operating capacity, 91.25% utilization, 71.31% debt ratio and 90.12% revenue from the largest customer.
rows.model_impact: Qinhuai receives earnings credit with leverage and customer-concentration haircuts.
rows.formal_boundary: 2026 full-year EBITDA, post-closing financing cost and integration capex are not disclosed

rows.claim: The old CNY43 target overstated optionality and omitted dilution.

rows.formal_boundary: actual placement amount and price remain unknown
